global_versioning.rule: The application build is global. Classic/Market engine versions are component references, not the Administrator application version.

windows: Atlas Math Core / Math Core Métaux
operator_compositions: Target Top + Market Flow + Market + Math Core
Any subset of the twelve windows can be minimized, detached or restored without stopping its business runtime.

domain_contract.graph: Graphique carries the active technical reading panel with it
domain_contract.target: one operational window switches visual content between Target Top 5 and Target Métaux
domain_contract.flow: one operational window switches visual content between Market Flow and Metals Flow
domain_contract.market: one operational window switches visual content between crypto Market Snapshot and the metals market snapshot/registry
domain_contract.math: the same Math Core DOM is preserved and follows the Classic domain placement logic

minimize_contract.implementation: native nodes are masked and replaced temporarily by a compact Administrator mini-bar; restore reveals the same original nodes
minimize_contract.graph_fix: Graphique is now fully masked on minimize; Lecture technique/Lecture Métaux is included with it
minimize_contract.missions_fix: Missions de vie and all native child programs are hidden/restored as one coherent window
